title: 8336 metr chuqurlikda suratga olingan baliq

scenes.text: 2022 yilda olimlar Yaponiya yaqinida 8336 metr chuqurlikda baliqni suratga olishdi.
Bu salyangoz baliqlar oilasiga mansub, juda kichik baliq edi.
U yerda bosim yer yuzidagidan taxminan 800 marta kuchli.
Uning suyaklari yumshoq, tanasi jelega o'xshaydi. Bu bosimga chidashga yordam beradi.
Olimlar fikricha, baliqlar taxminan 8400 metrdan chuqurroqda yashay olmaydi.

description:
2022 yilda Yaponiya va Avstraliya olimlari Izu-Ogasavara xandagida 8336 metr chuqurlikda salyangoz baliqni suratga olishdi. Natija 2023 yil aprelida e'lon qilindi va o'sha paytda bu eng chuqurda suratga olingan baliq edi.

Siz buni bilarmidingiz? Izohda "ha" yoki "yo'q" deb yozing.
source: University of Western Australia / Minderoo-UWA Deep Sea Research Centre press release, April 2023 (with Tokyo University of Marine Science and Technology): snailfish of the genus Pseudoliparis filmed at 8,336 m in the Izu-Ogasawara Trench in 2022 (press coverage gives Aug or Sept 2022), deepest fish ever filmed as of April 2023; Alan Jamieson's estimate that fish cannot live much below about 8,200-8,400 m; Guinness World Records: deepest fish
